Earlier senescence, autophagy and corpus context is known; this is not blind or independent acceptance. Scientific requirements, source-fit attestations and production contracts are distinct.

requirements.requirement: Living durable division arrest is distinct from death, continuing metabolism and separately tested secretions; low proliferation or p21 alone is insufficient.
Senescence is not ageing, quiescence or T-cell exhaustion; no fixed SASP mixture, universal permanence or marker cutoff, inevitable relapse, harm ranking or treatment rule is inferred.
The two fictional rows begin with the same two closed double-membrane autophagosomes and matched cargo; a snapshot count is not a measured LC3 flux or survival-dependence result.

The upper example has delivered cargo and inner-membrane fragments in a closed single-limiting-membrane degradative compartment, with schematic breakdown-product return across that boundary; membrane handling and product return are separate from synthesis of new material.

If degradation is blocked, already delivered cargo can remain recognisable in one fused compartment without product exit; this is a conditional later event, not proof that delivery itself paused or a universal blockage diagnosis.

Amount, delivery, degradation, product return and survival dependence require different evidence. No illustrative count, morphology or conditional row establishes a dependency, drug efficacy or patient benefit.
Locate damage to vulnerable membrane lipids as distinct from a generic ROS increase; oxidation alone does not diagnose ferroptotic cell death.
GPX4 and FSP1 are parallel example protective systems rather than all defences or an obligatory single chain; abundance is not established activity or dependence.
A membrane-damage schematic requires converging death/perturbation evidence and supplies no compound sensitivity, clinical benefit or expression-based treatment-selection conclusion.

In a contextual full-length AR example, transcription-regulatory, DNA-binding, linker and ligand-binding regions differ; hormone binding and DNA interaction are not one pocket or an every-variant rule.
Hormone-responsive nuclear movement and DNA regulation depend on receptor form, partners and accessible DNA; a schematic nuclear route is distinct from an AR abundance measurement.
AR amount, subcellular location, transcription and growth dependence need separate measurements; receptor activation or location does not independently establish dependence.
AR or an LAR research profile does not imply ER positivity, transfer a prostate indication to another cancer, rank antagonists or establish a variant-specific drug response.
An acetyl mark on a histone/protein, the BET reader and reader-pocket recognition are different objects/functions; a reader does not write the mark.
The generic BET strip has BD1, BD2 and an ET interaction region, with one representative pocket drawn. Not every bromodomain is BET, and family members are not interchangeable.
Pocket occupation leaves the acetyl mark and other protein regions present, while verified protein depletion is a different perturbation affecting more than the selected pocket.
The symbolic comparison establishes neither single-domain inhibitor specificity nor a BRD3-variant-to-BRD4-dependence or clinical-response claim; depletion itself needs measurement.
The membrane-anchored ligand stays on the sender cell; receptor and released intracellular domain belong to the receiver, whose nucleus is the destination. Adjacent plasma membranes remain distinct.
The drawing preserves an extracellular cut followed by an intramembrane cut in the receiver receptor; it does not move the sender ligand into the receiving nucleus.
KEAP1 adaptor/CUL3-complex-dependent NRF2 tagging and destruction are substrate-specific turnover examples; CUL3 has other adaptors and substrates.

Stress can reduce KEAP1-dependent tagging/turnover and make more NRF2 available for nuclear regulation without requiring every KEAP1-NRF2 interaction to dissociate; arrows indicate regulation, not NRF2 creation.

A universal physical-release latch is not the model. Defence abundance or a CUL3 variant does not establish NRF2 dependence or ferroptosis sensitivity; shared proteasome selection/tagging/recycling is a separate broader process.
Class I PI3K converts PIP2 to PIP3, opposed by PTEN; lipid phosphorylation and AKT/mTOR protein-substrate phosphorylation are distinct measurements.
PIP3-associated AKT recruitment, PDK1 Thr308 phosphorylation and mTORC2 Ser473 phosphorylation are separate steps; one universal linear route is not implied.
mTORC1 and mTORC2 are distinct complexes. The mTORC1 illustration includes growth/resource inputs and protein-production regulation without claiming all partners or chemical topology are drawn.
The indirect AKT-to-mTORC1 relationship needs intervening regulators; it must not be relabelled a direct phosphorylation edge or an unconditional chain.
Possible mTORC1 restraint of autophagy initiation is separate from completed degradative flux; RNA score or one timing marker does not establish kinase activity, dependence or inhibitor benefit.

The separate fictional perturbation-response inset is a possible observation with no inferred causal connection from timing and no clinical-benefit claim; signed/dashed arrow meanings and schematic phosphate counts remain explicit conventions.
